_description: The Milky Way dome's texture — GENERATED by tools/pipeline/build-sky-dome.js --write (plan 28 §A). A STATIC manifest (no tier table): one map at every epoch, drawn in the Galactic frame through the catalogue stars' J2000 frame (packages/physics/src/sky/galactic-frame.cjs), the texture's horizontal repeat −1 because the image is authored as seen from inside and three's inside-sphere mapping mirrors it. The gate tools/verify/surface-tiers.js checks the file against `files` and the source's licence record.

frame.coordinates: Galactic (IAU 1958, at J2000): the equator is the Galactic plane, the centre column (u = 0.5) the Galactic centre, the top the north Galactic pole
frame.measured: the band plane 0.66° from the image equator, the bulge's brightness maximum at u = 0.508 (the bulge's dust asymmetry; the published frame is used), the Magellanic Clouds at the mirrored Galactic longitudes under three's inside-sphere mapping (doc 111 §1.47)

recipe.what: every pixel clipped to its local background (a 9×9 median at half resolution, plus 4 % of the range): the resolved stars flattened, the unresolved grain and the dust lanes kept — so the only resolved stars in the scene are the catalogue's

eso0932a.title: The Milky Way panorama (360-degree panoramic image of the whole celestial sphere)
eso0932a.changes: resized, the stars removed and the image blurred as the recipe records — a derivative, stated as CC BY 4.0 requires
